item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the candle picture. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created.

I'd already picked the cheapest settings your free plan allows: one square image at 640px using z-image-turbo, which costs about 5 credits. A smaller or cheaper version wouldn't get past the credit limit either.

**To get the image:**
1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account at magichour.ai, either by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan. Free plans may also refill credits over time.
2. Tell me when that's done and I'll run it again.

This is the picture I'll make: a frosted amber glass jar candle with a simple cream label and a lit wick. It sits on light marble next to dried lavender and eucalyptus, with soft window light and a plain beige background. If you'd like a different scent, jar or setting, tell me and I'll change it before running it.
